name: Winbond Electronics Corp
blurb: Winbond Electronics Corp is a Taiwanese semiconductor company specializing in memory IC products, including DRAM, NOR Flash, and SLC NAND Flash. It is one of the leading memory manufacturers in Taiwan, with a focus on specialty DRAM and code storage flash memory. The company serves various markets such as automotive, industrial, and consumer electronics.
recent: In the past 30 days, Winbond's stock price has risen significantly, closing at NT$114.0 on May 7, 2026, up 5.07% from the previous close. The stock has been on a three-day winning streak with a cumulative gain of 20.82%. News highlights include potential benefits from a Samsung strike, which could boost DRAM prices and benefit Winbond and Nanya Technology.
